alt: 展覽桌上，一座精巧木橋穩穩承受多顆石頭，旁邊模型較簡單，老師與同學向製作者鼓掌。
scene_prompt: At a school model-bridge exhibition, one child stands modestly beside a sturdy, beautifully engineered wooden bridge model holding a small stack of smooth stones without sagging. Several other children's simpler bridges on adjacent tables have only one stone each and are visibly less developed but undamaged. A teacher and classmates warmly recognize the outstanding student's achievement with genuine impressed gestures and applause. The focus is earned distinction through excellent work, not physical height or a head rising from earth. No ribbons, grades, text, numerals or exaggerated celebrity effects.
